scope: Opt-in rotate_mac_each_pin; default false. Original normal continuous-process and quick paths remain selected when disabled.
architecture: Shared preparation policy plus owned-interface WpsSourceRotation and isolated native one-candidate orchestration. No copied PIN enumeration, extra UI timers, patched native binaries or persistent address history.
behavior: Checkbox immediately after source MAC field. Requires source spoofing. Fixed/manual field disabled but its saved value retained while rotating. Offline mode disables the option; direct unsupported requests reject rather than silently ignore it.

New ephemeral source for every new task and every target first candidate. A task preparation marker prevents accidental regeneration while the same options move between existing layers. Marker is not part of persisted settings.
Source and channel verified before launch using existing ownership guards. Same candidate retries keep one source; a different source is used only at a complete candidate boundary.

Normal rotation uses native -g 1, requires the one-attempt exit marker and validates advancing native session indices before restarting. Initial session import/order preparation happens once; later launches use the same remote session without re-importing stale local state.
Quick rotation uses a disposable session per fixed candidate with the same existing finite target budget. Preparation that consumes the budget does not launch another process.

No response for 60 seconds, cancellation, process stop errors, progress transfer failures and verification errors do not trigger another candidate launch. Existing owned cleanup, checkpoints and diagnostic history remain in use.
Additional -g and -q arguments are rejected only when rotation is enabled because they conflict with the verified boundary and its marker.

compatibility.conclusion: Both exact upstream versions count rejected candidates toward max attempts, advance native indices, and save sessions after returning from crack(). Existing source/channel readback remains conditional on real driver support. The desktop policy is common Python on Windows and Debian 12.
compatibility.other_reaver_builds: No certification; missing native boundary or advancing checkpoint stops continuation.

performance.memory: Constant state: last address and three native progress indices. Existing native session files are overwritten atomically, not accumulated per candidate.
performance.cost: Enabled mode restarts the native process and verifies owned interface state per candidate; it can be slower than the default continuous process. Disabled mode does not add this work.

acceptance: Restart source application, select one authorized target, enable spoofing and per-candidate rotation. Verify captured source addresses and successful interaction on the real adapter, including stop/restart and normal cleanup. No success claim before this test.
